$comment: Outcome badge for Change Requests Status and RAID Escalation status: green approved, red rejected/declined/overdue, amber waiting, grey other. The words always show.

style.border: =if(@currentField == 'Rejected' || @currentField == 'Declined' || @currentField == 'Decision overdue' || @currentField == 'Not decided', '1px solid #b91c1c', if(@currentField == 'Approved', '1px solid #15803d', if(indexOf(@currentField, 'Under review') == 0 || @currentField == 'Submitted' || @currentField == 'Requested', '1px solid #b45309', '1px solid #9ca3af')))
